messages.subject: Lyra — your witness statement & possible interview
messages.plaintextBody:
Neil,

Thanks for your time today. I've drafted your witness statement covering the cell, the interlock defeat, the key control and the remediation. I'll send it for your review tomorrow — please don't forward it on, as it's privileged.

If the HSE asks to interview you under caution, that's your right to have us present and we'd prepare you beforehand. Nothing to worry about, but let's be ready.

Tom

--
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
